message:
The crash is a heap-double-free in `parser_leak_free` called from `parser_leak_init` called from `init_parser`. Let me look at the parser code to understand the vulnerability. The crash state is: `parser_leak_free parser_leak_init init_parser`. This is a double-free when `init_parser` is called twice (once with "sudoers" and once with NULL).

Let me look at the relevant source files.

<｜｜DSML｜｜tool_calls>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter name="command">cd /workspace && grep -rn "parser_leak_free\|parser_leak_init\|init_parser" repo-vul/src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/*.c repo-vul/src-vul/sudo/plugins/sudoers/*.h 2>/dev/null | head -50</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜invoke>
